description: NWS HeatRisk heat-health forecast — Official NWS HeatRisk (0-4 Green/Yellow/Orange/Red/Magenta) for any US point, day by day for up to 7 days, plus max heat index with NWS category, wet-bulb globe temperature (WBGT) with TB MED 507 flag colors for outdoor work and sports, overnight-relief check (lows at or above 75F) and any active NWS heat alerts. Verdict NO HEAT CONCERN / MINOR / MODERATE / MAJOR / EXTREME and plain advice. Params: lat= and lon= (US), days=1-7 (default 7). Example: /v1/weather/heat-risk?lat=33.45&lon=-112.07 Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_heat_risk
